lines.en: Salt crust cracks and falls from my ankles.
I am half a step faster than an ordinary zombie.
Brine, not blood, runs through my veins.

lines.zh: 每一步都留下白色盐印。
lines.en: Each step leaves a white salt print.

lines.zh: 我不怕晒，太阳晒不干我。
lines.en: I fear no sun; it cannot dry me out.

lines.zh: 狂暴盐尸把我从盐里叫起来。
lines.en: The raging salt zombie called me out of the salt.
My legs are stiff as pickled wood.
I walk toward noise, faster than my kin.
Salt grains fill the cracks under my nails.
I cross the salt flat and the ground turns whiter.

lines.zh: 这具身体被盐保存得很好。
lines.en: Salt has kept this body very well.

lines.zh: 眼睛干得发涩，却还能看。
lines.en: My eyes are dry and gritty, yet they see.

lines.zh: 我站着，盐粒在皮肤下响。
lines.en: I stand still; salt grains click beneath my skin.
No heartbeat, only salt grinding.

lines.zh: 我张合手指，关节掉白粉。
lines.en: I flex my fingers and white dust falls.
A crust of salt has formed on my tongue.

lines.zh: 我不需要呼吸，但还会张嘴。
lines.en: I need no air, yet my mouth still opens.

lines.zh: 盐商把我埋在盐堆里多少年。
lines.en: How many years did the salt traders bury me?

lines.zh: 我记得被撒盐时那种刺痛。
lines.en: I remember the sting when they poured salt on me.

lines.zh: 身上每一道缝都填满了盐。
lines.en: Salt fills every seam of this body.

lines.zh: 太阳照着，我的影子很淡。
lines.en: The sun is out; my shadow is faint.

lines.zh: 我等着那声召唤，一直等着。
lines.en: I wait for that summoning cry, always waiting.
You carry no salty smell.
Living skin looks so soft.
Have you come to pour salt?

lines.zh: 你眨眼了，我数不清几回。
lines.en: You blinked; I lost count of how many.
Your shadow is darker than mine.

lines.zh: 站在这里，盐会爬上你的鞋。
lines.en: Stand here and salt climbs your boots.

lines.zh: 我在闻你，闻你出不出汗。
lines.en: I am sniffing you, checking if you sweat.

lines.zh: 那副手套，能挡住我的牙吗？
lines.en: Will those gloves stop my teeth?

lines.zh: 你走路的声音，我记住了。
lines.en: I have memorized the sound of your steps.

lines.zh: 你算活物，还是也算腌货？
lines.en: Are you living, or also pickled?
That one went into my salt crust.
I cracked, but I will not scatter.
Salt fell everywhere; do not step on it.
You broke one of my knuckles.
I died long ago; blows do not hurt.
A corner of my shoulder caved in.
The salt is still taking the hits for me.
You hit hard; sadly I am hard.
White dust flew into your eyes, did it not?
Keep hitting and the salt runs out.
Rotten flesh? That stuff is too soft.
I want only salt; all else is bland.
Wave that meat; I will not move.
Only a salt block suits my teeth.

lines.zh: 我嗓子干，可我不想喝水。
lines.en: My throat is dry, but I do not want water.

lines.zh: 你把盐撒地上，我或许会来。
lines.en: Spill salt on the ground and maybe I will come.
That smell is a living man's dinner.

lines.zh: 我不饿，我只是习惯张嘴。
lines.en: I am not hungry; opening my mouth is habit.
Put it away; I do not eat cooked food.
Offering rotten flesh, as if to a child.
Bump me and salt falls down your collar.
You block me; my shoulder is hard.
Do not shove; the salt on me will crumble.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，像两块盐岩。
lines.en: We collide like two lumps of rock salt.

lines.zh: 你退开，我的骨头没感觉。
lines.en: Step aside; my bones feel nothing.

lines.zh: 这一碰，蹭白了你半边袖子。
lines.en: That touch whitened half your sleeve.

lines.zh: 我比你重，因为灌满了盐。
lines.en: I am heavier, being filled with salt.

lines.zh: 挤过来，你的盔甲会生锈。
lines.en: Come closer and your armor will rust.
I stand firm; my toes grip the ground.

lines.zh: 你的肩膀碰得我盐壳直响。
lines.en: Your shoulder makes my salt crust rattle.
Nothing young is born from salt.

lines.zh: 我没有那个念头，早被腌掉了。
lines.en: That urge was pickled out of me.

lines.zh: 同伴是召唤来的，不是生的。
lines.en: My kin are summoned, not born.

lines.zh: 你找错东西了，我只会站着。
lines.en: You seek the wrong thing; I only stand.
Salt corpses do not breed; they pile up.
This body lost that long ago.
Do not do that in front of me.

lines.zh: 我的血是卤水，养不活什么。
lines.en: My blood is brine; it nourishes nothing.

lines.zh: 盐会一直保存我，不会续代。
lines.en: Salt preserves me, never continues me.

lines.zh: 去找活的吧，它们还有温度。
lines.en: Go find the living; they still have warmth.

lines.zh: 那东西掉在地上，我捡不起来。
lines.en: It fell; my fingers cannot pick it up.
My fingers are too stiff to pinch.
Salt has glued my joints shut.
I have no strength left to compete.

lines.zh: 我弯不下腰，脊背像板子。
lines.en: I cannot bend; my spine is a plank.

lines.zh: 亮的东西，我看得见却拿不到。
lines.en: I see the shiny thing, and cannot take it.
Fall into the salt, and it belongs to the salt.

lines.zh: 我的手掌磨穿了，抓不牢。
lines.en: My palm is worn through; nothing stays gripped.

lines.zh: 那枚东西，是我生前的吗？
lines.en: Is that trinket from when I lived?

lines.zh: 放下吧，我的手只会往下掉。
lines.en: Leave it; my hand only drops things.

lines.zh: 活物的热气，我隔远就闻到。
lines.en: I smell living warmth from far away.
You moved; now I have you.

lines.zh: 盐尸叫我起来，就是为这个。
lines.en: The salt zombie raised me for this.

lines.zh: 我比同类快，你跑不掉的。
lines.en: I am faster than my kin; you cannot outrun me.
That breath, I must cut it off.
The target is set; my feet move on their own.
You crushed my salt crust.

lines.zh: 别跑，我追得比你想的快。
lines.en: Do not run; I am faster than you think.

lines.zh: 我看的是你喉咙那点热气。
lines.en: I am watching the warmth at your throat.
The one who summoned me wants you down.
The smell of you is enough.
It has been long since I chased the living.
When you move, my teeth itch.
I chose you; do not blame the salt.

lines.zh: 你踏碎的那层盐，是我的。
lines.en: That salt crust you broke was mine.
I circle to your flank, shifting slowly.
Change direction and I change with you.

lines.zh: 我的脚步很轻，虽然很硬。
lines.en: My steps are light, though stiff.
Do not turn; my salt arrives first.

lines.zh: 你的脚步，一步比一步乱。
lines.en: Your steps grow more scattered with each one.

lines.zh: 盐在我身后拖出一道线。
lines.en: Salt trails in a line behind me.
Raise your shield and I will wait.
I do not shout; no shout comes out.
The harder you breathe, the clearer you are.
This body is not quick, but it never stops.
I walk along your shadow.

lines.zh: 你退到墙角，我就不绕了。
lines.en: Back into a corner and I stop circling.

lines.zh: 隔着石头，我也听得见你。
lines.en: Even through stone, I hear you.

lines.zh: 我的牙在响，你听见了吗？
lines.en: My teeth are clicking; do you hear?

lines.zh: 我沿着盐线走，不偏一条缝。
lines.en: I walk the salt line, not a seam off.

lines.zh: 你站在盐堆后，那里不挡我。
lines.en: You stand behind a salt heap. It does not stop me.

lines.zh: 我的关节在响，那是催你跑。
lines.en: My joints creak. That is your cue to run.

lines.zh: 你藏在柱子后，盐味会出卖你。
lines.en: Hide behind the pillar. The salt smell gives you away.

lines.zh: 我的手落下，像一块盐砖。
lines.en: My hand falls like a brick of salt.
My teeth lock on and will not let go.
This swipe leaves a white mark.
Salt dust gets into your wound.
My strength was cured into me.
Fall; I am waiting for you to fall.

lines.zh: 打完这一下，我的盐掉了一层。
lines.en: After that blow, a layer of salt came off me.
A wooden sword will not stop this salt crust.
I have grabbed you by the collar.

lines.zh: 你的护甲在响，像被腌的罐子。
lines.en: Your armor rattles like a pickling jar.

lines.zh: 我不懂收手，召唤没教过。
lines.en: I never learned to hold back; no summons taught me.
This bite lands on your shoulder; enough.
The salt zombie strikes just like this.
Still standing? Then I come again.

lines.zh: 我的手按下去，指缝里全是盐。
lines.en: My hand comes down, salt packed in every crease.

lines.zh: 这一口不深，可盐已经进去了。
lines.en: Not a deep bite, but the salt is in you now.

lines.zh: 盐裂开了，我从缝里爬出。
lines.en: The salt split, and I crawl out.

lines.zh: 狂暴盐尸喊了一声，我醒了。
lines.en: The raging salt zombie cried out and I woke.
I lay in the salt layer far too long.

lines.zh: 白盐往下掉，落满我的肩。
lines.en: White salt slides down and covers my shoulders.
I have been called up to work again.
This place is cleaner than a grave.

lines.zh: 我以为自己会被腌到烂。
lines.en: I thought I would be pickled until I rotted.
My joints crack for the first time, ugly.
Where is my summoner? I am looking for you.
Salt leaks from my eye sockets.
These bones still remember standing.
The air is dry; I like it.
I crushed my own salt crust.

lines.zh: 谁把我从盐里翻出来的？
lines.en: Who dug me out of the salt?

lines.zh: 火焰烧着我，只把盐烤干。
lines.en: Fire surrounds me; it only dries the salt.

lines.zh: 摔下来，盐从我背上滚落。
lines.en: I fall and salt rolls off my back.
Sunk in water and the salt starts to melt.
The blast took half of me; salt mist everywhere.
The arrow sticks, gripped by my salt.

lines.zh: 魔法烧我的脑子，里面是盐。
lines.en: Magic burns my mind, and salt is inside it.
I cannot starve; salt does not eat.
Lightning splits my salt crust into a web.
The void soaks me apart.
